AllocZeroed.summary: Allocates a block of unmanaged memory for an array of the specified type and initializes all bytes to zero.
AllocZeroed.typeparam: The type of elements to allocate. Must be an unmanaged type.
AllocZeroed.param: The number of elements to allocate. Must be greater than zero.
AllocZeroed.returns: A pointer to the allocated memory block containing zero-initialized elements of type .

Alloc.summary: Allocates a block of unmanaged memory sufficient to hold the specified number of elements.
Alloc.typeparam: The type of elements to allocate. Must be an unmanaged type.
Alloc.param: The number of elements to allocate. Must be greater than zero.
Alloc.returns: A pointer to the allocated block of unmanaged memory containing the specified number of elements.

Free.summary: Releases the unmanaged memory allocated for a specified number of elements.
Free.typeparam: The type of elements in the buffer. Must be an unmanaged type.
Free.param: A pointer to the memory buffer containing the elements to be freed. Must not be null.
The number of elements in the buffer. Must be greater than zero.

Clear.summary: Clears the specified buffer by setting all elements to zero.
Clear.typeparam: The type of the elements in the buffer. Must be an unmanaged type.
Clear.param: A pointer to the buffer whose contents will be cleared.
The number of elements in the buffer to clear. Must be greater than zero.

Copy.summary: Copies a specified number of elements from a source memory location to a destination memory location.
Copy.typeparam: The type of elements to copy. Must be an unmanaged type.
Copy.param: A pointer to the source memory location from which elements are copied. Cannot be null.
A pointer to the destination memory location where elements are copied. Cannot be null.
The number of elements to copy from the source to the destination. Must be a non-negative integer.
